title: The Human Chair
synopsis: Ziwen continues reading the mysterious letter from an anonymous sender, who reveals more about his true purpose.

fullText.simplified:
在这个椅子里，我感受到了不一样的世界。在那里，你所感受到的人，和平常看到的人是不一样的。我们一般都是通过看人的脸来认识每一个人，但在这个椅子里，我是通过人的声音、脚步声、气味和与他大腿的接触来认识人。
    我对于女人的认识也和以前完全不同了。我们喜欢一个女生，一般是从喜欢她的样子开始的。你觉得她长得好看，就会更容易喜欢上她。但是在这椅子的世界里，好不好看完全不重要，这里只有声音、气味和与她接触时的感觉。
    而我，在这张椅子中，深深地爱上了一名女子。她是第一个坐上我这把椅子的女子。
    听她的声音，她应该是一个年轻的外国女子。当时房间里正好没人，她好像有什么高兴的事，一边小声地唱着歌，一边跳着走进了休息室，在我的椅子上坐了下来。她在我的腿上时而唱歌，时而跟着歌声轻轻地左右动着身子。
    对我来说，这真是一个大事件！你要知道，在这之前，我从来没有跟女人有过那么近的接触。而现在，我却和一个不认识的外国女子，在一间房子里，共同坐在一把椅子上。她是那么放心地坐在我的腿上，表现出只有在没有人时才有的放松。虽然隔着椅子的皮革，但是我感觉我正在抱着她。
    自从有了这个惊人的发现，我刚开始偷东西的目的已经不再重要了，因为我爱上了这种与人接触的感觉。我想，可能这个椅子的世界才是我真正想要的世界。像我这样的丑八怪，在现实世界里，只能过着又穷又没意思的生活。但是，在这个小小的、黑暗的椅子世界里，我就能接触到在现实世界里不可能接触到的美丽女人，“抱”着她们，听她们说话。
    这就是椅中之恋！这是只有触觉、听觉的恋情，这是黑暗世界中的恋情！
fullText.traditional:
在這個椅子裡，我感受到了不一樣的世界。在那裡，你所感受到的人，和平常看到的人是不一樣的。我們一般都是通過看人的臉來認識每一個人，但在這個椅子裡，我是通過人的聲音、腳步聲、氣味和與他大腿的接觸來認識人。
    我對於女人的認識也和以前完全不同了。我們喜歡一個女生，一般是從喜歡她的樣子開始的。你覺得她長得好看，就會更容易喜歡上她。但是在這椅子的世界裡，好不好看完全不重要，這裡只有聲音、氣味和與她接觸時的感覺。
    而我，在這張椅子中，深深地愛上了一名女子。她是第一個坐上我這把椅子的女子。
    聽她的聲音，她應該是一個年輕的外國女子。當時房間裡正好沒人，她好像有什麼高興的事，一邊小聲地唱著歌，一邊跳著走進了休息室，在我的椅子上坐了下來。她在我的腿上時而唱歌，時而跟著歌聲輕輕地左右動著身子。
    對我來說，這真是一個大事件！你要知道，在這之前，我從來沒有跟女人有過那麼近的接觸。而現在，我卻和一個不認識的外國女子，在一間房子裡，共同坐在一把椅子上。她是那麼放心地坐在我的腿上，表現出只有在沒有人時才有的放鬆。雖然隔著椅子的皮革，但是我感覺我正在抱著她。
    自從有了這個驚人的發現，我剛開始偷東西的目的已經不再重要了，因為我愛上了這種與人接觸的感覺。我想，可能這個椅子的世界才是我真正想要的世界。像我這樣的醜八怪，在現實世界裡，只能過著又窮又沒意思的生活。但是，在這個小小的、黑暗的椅子世界裡，我就能接觸到在現實世界裡不可能接觸到的美麗女人，“抱”著她們，聽她們說話。
    這就是椅中之戀！這是只有觸覺、聽覺的戀情，這是黑暗世界中的戀情！

sentences.simplified: 在这个椅子里，我感受到了不一样的世界。
sentences.traditional: 在這個椅子裡，我感受到了不一樣的世界。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè ge yǐ zi lǐ wǒ gǎn shòu dào le bù yí yàng de shì jiè
sentences.english: I felt like I was in a different world inside that chair.

sentences.simplified: 在那里，你所感受到的人，和平常看到的人是不一样的。
sentences.traditional: 在那裡，你所感受到的人，和平常看到的人是不一樣的。
sentences.pinyin: zài nà lǐ nǐ suǒ gǎn shòu dào de rén hé píng cháng kàn dào de rén shì bù yí yàng de
sentences.english: The people that you sense when you are there are different from the people that you normally see.

sentences.simplified: 我们一般都是通过看人的脸来认识每一个人，
sentences.traditional: 我們一般都是通過看人的臉來認識每一個人，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men yì bān dōu shì tōng guò kàn rén de liǎn lái rèn shi měi yí ge rén
sentences.english: We usually recognize people by looking at their faces.

sentences.simplified: 但在这个椅子里，我是通过人的声音、脚步声、气味和与他大腿的接触来认识人。
sentences.traditional: 但在這個椅子裡，我是通過人的聲音、腳步聲、氣味和與他大腿的接觸來認識人。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zài zhè ge yǐ zi lǐ wǒ shì tōng guò rén de shēng yīn jiǎo bù shēng qì wèi hé yǔ tā dà tuǐ de jiē chù lái rèn shi rén
sentences.english: But inside the chair, I recognized people by their voices, footsteps, smell, and contact with their thighs.

sentences.simplified: 我对于女人的认识也和以前完全不同了。
sentences.traditional: 我對於女人的認識也和以前完全不同了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ duì yú nǚ rén de rèn shi yě hé yǐ qián wán quán bù tóng le
sentences.english: My understanding of women was also completely different from the past.

sentences.simplified: 我们喜欢一个女生，一般是从喜欢她的样子开始的。
sentences.traditional: 我們喜歡一個女生，一般是從喜歡她的樣子開始的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men xǐ huan yí ge nǚ shēng yì bān shì cóng xǐ huan tā de yàng zi kāi shǐ de
sentences.english: When we like a girl, we usually start by liking her appearance.

sentences.simplified: 你觉得她长得好看，就会更容易喜欢上她。
sentences.traditional: 你覺得她長得好看，就會更容易喜歡上她。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ jué de tā zhǎng de hǎo kàn jiù huì gèng róng yì xǐ huan shàng tā
sentences.english: If you think that she is good looking, then it is easier to like her.

sentences.simplified: 但是在这椅子的世界里，好不好看完全不重要，
sentences.traditional: 但是在這椅子的世界裡，好不好看完全不重要，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zài zhè yǐ zi de shì jiè lǐ hǎo bù hǎo kàn wán quán bú zhòng yào
sentences.english: But in the world inside the chair, whether or not she is good looking is not important at all.

sentences.simplified: 这里只有声音、气味和与她接触时的感觉。
sentences.traditional: 這裡只有聲音、氣味和與她接觸時的感覺。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ zhǐ yǒu shēng yīn qì wèi hé yǔ tā jiē chù shí de gǎn jué
sentences.english: Here, you only can only feel her voice, smell, and touch.

sentences.simplified: 而我，在这张椅子中，深深地爱上了一名女子。
sentences.traditional: 而我，在這張椅子中，深深地愛上了一名女子。
sentences.pinyin: ér wǒ zài zhè zhāng yǐ zi zhōng shēn shēn de ài shàng le yì míng nǚ zǐ
sentences.english: And inside that chair, I fell deeply in love with one girl.

sentences.simplified: 她是第一个坐上我这把椅子的女子。
sentences.traditional: 她是第一個坐上我這把椅子的女子。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì dì yí ge zuò shàng wǒ zhè bǎ yǐ zi de nǚ zǐ
sentences.english: She was the first girl who sat on my chair.

sentences.simplified: 听她的声音，她应该是一个年轻的外国女子。
sentences.traditional: 聽她的聲音，她應該是一個年輕的外國女子。
sentences.pinyin: tīng tā de shēng yīn tā yīng gāi shì yí ge nián qīng de wài guó nǚ zǐ
sentences.english: From listening to her voice, she was probably a young, foreign girl.

sentences.simplified: 当时房间里正好没人，她好像有什么高兴的事，
sentences.traditional: 當時房間裡正好沒人，她好像有什麼高興的事，
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí fáng jiān lǐ zhèng hǎo méi rén tā hǎo xiàng yǒu shén me gāo xìng de shì
sentences.english: At that time there happened to be no one in the room. It seemed that she was happy about something.

sentences.simplified: 一边小声地唱着歌，一边跳着走进了休息室，在我的椅子上坐了下来。
sentences.traditional: 一邊小聲地唱著歌，一邊跳著走進了休息室，在我的椅子上坐了下來。
sentences.pinyin: yì biān xiǎo shēng de chàng zhe gē yì biān tiào zhe zǒu jìn le xiū xī shì zài wǒ de yǐ zi shang zuò le xia lai
sentences.english: She sung in a low voice as she skipped into the lounge and sat down on my chair.

sentences.simplified: 她在我的腿上时而唱歌，
sentences.traditional: 她在我的腿上時而唱歌，
sentences.pinyin: tā zài wǒ de tuǐ shang shí ér chàng gē
sentences.english: She continued to sing as she sat on my leg.

sentences.simplified: 时而跟着歌声轻轻地左右动着身子。
sentences.traditional: 時而跟著歌聲輕輕地左右動著身子。
sentences.pinyin: shí ér gēn zhe gē shēng qīng qīng de zuǒ yòu dòng zhe shēn zi
sentences.english: Occasionally, she gently moved her body left and right with the song.

sentences.simplified: 对我来说，这真是一个大事件！
sentences.traditional: 對我來說，這真是一個大事件！
sentences.pinyin: duì wǒ lái shuō zhè zhēn shi yí ge dà shì jiàn
sentences.english: For me, this was a really a big deal!

sentences.simplified: 你要知道，在这之前，我从来没有跟女人有过那么近的接触。
sentences.traditional: 你要知道，在這之前，我從來沒有跟女人有過那麼近的接觸。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yào zhī dào zài zhè zhī qián wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu gēn nǚ rén yǒu guò nà me jìn de jiē chù
sentences.english: You should know that before this, I had never been in such close contact with a woman before.

sentences.simplified: 而现在，我却和一个不认识的外国女子，在一间房子里，共同坐在一把椅子上。
sentences.traditional: 而現在，我卻和一個不認識的外國女子，在一間房子裡，共同坐在一把椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: ér xiàn zài wǒ què hé yí ge bú rèn shi de wài guó nǚ zǐ zài yì jiān fáng zi lǐ gòng tóng zuò zài yì bǎ yǐ zi shang
sentences.english: But now, I was in a room with a foreign girl who I didn’t know, sitting together on a chair.

sentences.simplified: 她是那么放心地坐在我的腿上，表现出只有在没有人时才有的放松。
sentences.traditional: 她是那麼放心地坐在我的腿上，表現出只有在沒有人時才有的放鬆。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì nà me fàng xīn de zuò zài wǒ de tuǐ shang biǎo xiàn chū zhǐ yǒu zài méi yǒu rén shí cái yǒu de fàng sōng
sentences.english: She was so at ease when she sat on my leg. She was relaxed in a way that is only possible when no one else is around.

sentences.simplified: 虽然隔着椅子的皮革，但是我感觉我正在抱着她。
sentences.traditional: 雖然隔著椅子的皮革，但是我感覺我正在抱著她。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán gé zhe yǐ zi de pí gé dàn shì wǒ gǎn jué wǒ zhèng zài bào zhe tā
sentences.english: Even though we were separated by the leather of the chair, I felt like I was embracing her.

sentences.simplified: 自从有了这个惊人的发现，我刚开始偷东西的目的已经不再重要了，
sentences.traditional: 自從有了這個驚人的發現，我剛開始偷東西的目的已經不再重要了，
sentences.pinyin: zì cóng yǒu le zhè ge jīng rén de fā xiàn wǒ gāng kāi shǐ tōu dōng xi de mù dì yǐ jīng bú zài zhòng yào le
sentences.english: After this astonishing discovery, my initial goal to steal was no longer important, ..

sentences.simplified: 因为我爱上了这种与人接触的感觉。
sentences.traditional: 因為我愛上了這種與人接觸的感覺。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi wǒ ài shàng le zhè zhǒng yǔ rén jiē chù de gǎn jué
sentences.english: .. because I fell in love with the feeling being close to another person.

sentences.simplified: 我想，可能这个椅子的世界才是我真正想要的世界。
sentences.traditional: 我想，可能這個椅子的世界才是我真正想要的世界。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kě néng zhè ge yǐ zi de shì jiè cái shì wǒ zhēn zhèng xiǎng yào de shì jiè
sentences.english: I thought to myself, maybe the world of the chair is the world that I really want.

sentences.simplified: 像我这样的丑八怪，在现实世界里，只能过着又穷又没意思的生活。
sentences.traditional: 像我這樣的醜八怪，在現實世界裡，只能過著又窮又沒意思的生活。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng wǒ zhè yàng de chǒu bā guài zài xiàn shí shì jiè lǐ zhǐ néng guò zhe yòu qióng yòu méi yì si de shēng huó
sentences.english: In the real world, an ugly person like me can only live a poor and meaningless life.

sentences.simplified: 但是，在这个小小的、黑暗的椅子世界里，
sentences.traditional: 但是，在這個小小的、黑暗的椅子世界裡，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zài zhè ge xiǎo xiǎo de hēi àn de yǐ zi shì jiè lǐ
sentences.english: However, in this small, dark world of the chair, ..

sentences.simplified: 我就能接触到在现实世界里不可能接触到的美丽女人，
sentences.traditional: 我就能接觸到在現實世界裡不可能接觸到的美麗女人，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiù néng jiē chù dào zài xiàn shí shì jiè lǐ bù kě néng jiē chù dào de měi lì nǚ rén
sentences.english: .. I was able to get close to beautiful women that I couldn’t get close to in the real world.

sentences.simplified: “抱”着她们，听她们说话。
sentences.traditional: “抱”著她們，聽她們說話。
sentences.pinyin: bào zhe tā men tīng tā men shuō huà
sentences.english: I “embraced” them and listened to them speak.

sentences.simplified: 这就是椅中之恋！
sentences.traditional: 這就是椅中之戀！
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì yǐ zhōng zhī liàn
sentences.english: This was love in this chair!

sentences.simplified: 这是只有触觉、听觉的恋情，这是黑暗世界中的恋情！
sentences.traditional: 這是只有觸覺、聽覺的戀情，這是黑暗世界中的戀情！
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì zhǐ yǒu chù jué tīng jué de liàn qíng zhè shì hēi àn shì jiè zhōng de liàn qíng
sentences.english: This love which only knows touch and hearing; love in a dark world!

sentence_translations: I felt like I was in a different world inside that chair.
The people that you sense when you are there are different from the people that you normally see.
We usually recognize people by looking at their faces.
But inside the chair, I recognized people by their voices, footsteps, smell, and contact with their thighs.
My understanding of women was also completely different from the past.
When we like a girl, we usually start by liking her appearance.
If you think that she is good looking, then it is easier to like her.
But in the world inside the chair, whether or not she is good looking is not important at all.
Here, you only can only feel her voice, smell, and touch.
And inside that chair, I fell deeply in love with one girl.
She was the first girl who sat on my chair.
From listening to her voice, she was probably a young, foreign girl.
At that time there happened to be no one in the room. It seemed that she was happy about something.
She sung in a low voice as she skipped into the lounge and sat down on my chair.
She continued to sing as she sat on my leg.
Occasionally, she gently moved her body left and right with the song.
For me, this was a really a big deal!
You should know that before this, I had never been in such close contact with a woman before.
But now, I was in a room with a foreign girl who I didn’t know, sitting together on a chair.
She was so at ease when she sat on my leg. She was relaxed in a way that is only possible when no one else is around.
Even though we were separated by the leather of the chair, I felt like I was embracing her.
After this astonishing discovery, my initial goal to steal was no longer important, ..
.. because I fell in love with the feeling being close to another person.
I thought to myself, maybe the world of the chair is the world that I really want.
In the real world, an ugly person like me can only live a poor and meaningless life.
However, in this small, dark world of the chair, ..
.. I was able to get close to beautiful women that I couldn’t get close to in the real world.
I “embraced” them and listened to them speak.
This was love in this chair!
This love which only knows touch and hearing; love in a dark world!
